authority: Explicit human reply in this task
question: ASR 是“read cash”，OCR 同时有“readCash / readCache”时，是否允许按原文字母规范成 readCash？
answer: 允许规范成 readCash，但不能无依据改成 readCache
rule: For an unquoted identifier, case/whitespace-only normalization to an OCR spelling matching source letters is allowed. Raw source spelling also remains allowed. A different-letter homophone still requires relevant distinguishing evidence. Literal quotes, negation, conditions, target identity, dates and requests retain their existing requirements.
limits: Extension to writeRight is the same case/whitespace rule. No blanket rule for punctuation/underscores, unrelated OCR facts, quoted replacements, or semantic contradictions. This policy permits normalization; it does not mandate it. Future experiments must freeze their new policy before qualification; historical selection decisions are not silently rewritten.
